"''That's right.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and Checkers|}} The '''Kessel encounter''' was a battle fought by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Laser Company]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Company/Legends|unit]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] against an anti-Republic force during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Except for the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Checkers]], all members of Laser Company were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the fight, and Checkers himself was severely wounded. ==Behind the scenes== The battle of Kessel was mentioned in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a [[2009]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' {{Ab|Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth (audiobook)}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Kessel (Klonkriege) }} [[Category:Battles of Kessel]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]]
